scope_notes: Only public SDK and command outputs were inspected in an owned private Rhino document.
Thirteen bounded SDK grip setups and three native PointsOn/SelAll/PointsOff workflows cover curves, rational controls, surfaces, meshes and mixed point objects.
Preselected grips remain selected through fitting and Undo/Redo. Postselected grips are deselected by getter cleanup after EndCommand, with their display retained.
Captures retain EndCommand and post-macro snapshots. Completed fits receive no idle cancellation tokens; earlier trailing Escape tokens had confounded history observations.
Global SelAll selects both displayed grips and their parents. FitPoints uses grips as definition inputs and retains unsupported preselected parents as peers.
Duplicate mesh vertices remain distinct inputs; rational control weights do not weight Euclidean grip coordinates.
PointsOff hides grips and clears their selection without adding a model Undo entry. Parent and ordinary point-object selection is retained, including through subsequent Circle Undo/Redo.

Application replay checks final script state, selection, source preservation, Circle center/radius and history through direct and incremental command paths. Mouse click/window tests are independent implementation tests, not native mouse captures.
Editing grips, idle Escape display cleanup, overlap menus, full periodic/composite behavior, native oriented Circle frames and full performance remain incomplete.
